verdict:
KILL, carried as a WATCH with a deep valuation gate and one BLOCKING data condition. No escalation trigger fires: benches concordant on outcome, no ADVANCE, not held, next print 2026-11-04 (yfinance-derived, UNCONFIRMED) roughly 55 trading days out.

THE HINGE, AND WHY BOTH POLES COLLAPSED. The triage's court-worthiness rested on a name that 'flips between 7.9x / ~31% ROE and value trap.' Red killed the cheap pole and blue confirmed the kill: H1'26 favorable prior-year development of $28.5M against H1'26 net income of $61.3M means reserve releases fund ~46.5% of earnings, and with near-zero tax the flow-through is close to dollar-for-dollar. Ex-development H1 is $32.8M, ~$66M annualized, which is ~12.1x on blue's re-measured ~$794M cap - not 7.9x - and ROE ~20%, not ~31%. Blue's one honest softening is worth keeping: zero-PYD is a FLOOR counterfactual, not a fair-value case, because conservatively-reserved insurers (PGR is the reference) release routinely; the honest band is ~10-12x. That is enough. At 2.4x book on untaxed earnings, ~10-12x is not asymmetry, it is a fair-to-full price for a monoline with an unearned rate give-back ahead of it.

WHERE BLUE CORRECTED RED, AND WHY IT DOES NOT RESCUE THE NAME. Red's accident-year deterioration of '~+2.7pts' was computed by mixing bases - net PYD divided by GROSS earned premium, compared against a gross ex-LAE calendar loss ratio. Blue recomputed on ONE basis (the rollforward is net and includes LAE): AY ratio = calendar-year incurred / NPE gives H1'26 494.6/727.2 = 68.0% vs H1'25 452.9/674.3 = 67.2%, i.e. +0.9pts, against a calendar net ratio that IMPROVED 1.0pt (65.1 -> 64.1) - a masking gap of ~1.9pts, not ~3.4pts. Red's own defence ('cession 1.2%, distortion small') cited only the current period; retention moved 94.2% -> 98.5% YoY, which is precisely the contamination. So this is NOT a value trap proven. But the direction survives intact - releases are accelerating while the accident year drifts worse, into a written-rate give-back that has not earned in yet - and the valuation pole that made the name interesting is gone either way.

THE RETENTION JUMP IS THE MOST IMPORTANT UNDER-WEIGHTED FACT. Blue found retention rising 94.2% -> 98.5%, which does three things at once: it explains red's basis artifact, it means materially higher volatility per dollar of equity, and it removes the quota-share cushion that would otherwise absorb an adverse accident year. Set against ~$1.45B NPW on $327.9M of GAAP equity, that makes the UNREAD statutory surplus question first-order. Both benches flagged it; neither closed it. This is why the reopen gate below is data-BLOCKING rather than price-only: a flush to the $34 gate would otherwise auto-trigger an entry into an unquantified statutory-capacity question at ~4.4x premium-to-GAAP-equity with the reinsurance cushion gone.

OTHER RULINGS. Untaxed earnings: $0.2M of tax on $25.6M of Q2 pretax under a FULL valuation allowance - red scored steady-state EPS ~22% lower, blue REDUCED it correctly, since a full VA implies large NOLs shielding CASH tax for years and the note contemplates release 'in the foreseeable future,' which is a pending one-time book-value catalyst red scored only as a penalty. Right for the terminal multiple, overstated near-term. Buyback: red said the shrink trend was unproven; blue strengthened this - the $20.8M / 0.4M shares figure is the SIX-month number, not Q2, so the original brief's '2.5% of cap per quarter' is ~2x overstated (~1.3%/qtr actual). Warrants: clean and verbatim confirmed - Carvana long-term warrants, max 7.2M Class A, strikes $180-$540, all far out of the money at ~$51, expiring 2027-09-01; TENX discipline satisfied. But note the corollary both benches drew and neither resolved: Carvana's equity incentive is functionally dead thirteen months before expiry while that channel sources 51% of new writings. That is a distribution-durability question sitting outside the numbers.

ENTRY IS DEGRADING, NOT IMPROVING. Verified live at adjudication: last $51.45, prior close $49.83 (+3.25% on the day), 52w high $104.47, 52w low $40.91. dd52 = -50.75%, matching the pack's -0.507 exactly; pct_off_low = +25.8%. Red quoted $49.83 / -52.3% / +21.8% (the 8/13 close) and blue quoted $51.26 / -50.9% / +25.3% (8/14 intraday) - blue is the accurate anchor and the pack agrees with blue. The tape has now bounced ~26% off its low and rallied another 3.25%; this is not a fresh dislocation and there is no forced seller anywhere in the record. The existing $34.00 ledger gate sits ~34% below spot, so the WATCH is effectively dormant - which is the correct posture. || SESSION RULING: RATIFIED KILL (concordant 8/7; blue's basis-mix correction noted). $34 gate stands but marked DATA-BLOCKING: the unread statutory surplus (~4.4x premium-to-equity at 98.5% retention) must be read before any flush-to-gate can seat a position.

court.record: batch 8/15; red 8/blue 7 PARTIALLY OVERTURNED on magnitude - outcome CONCORDANT. Blue cut red's headline number by ~3x on a basis-mixing artifact but sustained the direction and independently sustained REJECT-for-now.

reopen_gates: PRICE (valuation gate, existing, KEEP): <= $34.00. Basis is sound and survives both benches - ~8x the ~$66M ex-reserve-release annualized earnings floor on 15.49M shares (13,687,016 Class A + 1,806,236 Class B per the 10-Q cover page). Note this is a FLOOR counterfactual, so $34 is a genuinely conservative entry, not a fair-value estimate.

DATA - BLOCKING, must be closed BEFORE any entry even at the price gate: statutory surplus read against ~$1.45B NPW on $327.9M GAAP equity, with retention now at 98.5% (the quota-share cushion is gone). Both benches flagged this and neither closed it; blue calls it first-order. Doctrine: an unclosed first-order data gap kills, it does not gate - so a price trigger alone must NOT seat a position here.
DATA (secondary, no connector exists): SERFF state rate filings, to test whether the written rate give-back is achievable at >= 3%. Unread by both benches. Building the connector is the durable fix.

EVENT (blue's pre-registered re-open, primary): the Q3'26 loss-reserve rollforward showing PYD <= ~$5M for the quarter WITH accident-year loss picks flat-or-better. This is the single test that separates 'earnings funded by a depleting asset' from 'earnings.'
EVENT: net share count shrinking for two more consecutive quarters (actual pace is ~1.3%/qtr, not the 2.5%/qtr originally briefed).

STRUCTURAL WATCH-ITEM (not a gate, but must be priced at any re-court): Carvana sources 51% of new partnership/IA writings while its long-term warrants ($180-$540 strikes, expiring 2027-09-01) are functionally dead at ~$51. The distribution channel's equity alignment has evaporated thirteen months before expiry.
